newsitem.title: TURKEY: Air traffic returns to normal at Istanbul airport.
newsitem.headline: Air traffic returns to normal at Istanbul airport.

text.p: Air traffic resumed at Istanbul's Ataturk Airport following an early morning delay caused by dense fog over the city, officials said on Wednesday.
Earlier departures were delayed until around 1000 a.m. (0800 GMT) and planes to Istanbul landed in capital Ankara or the western town of Izmir when the airport was closed.
Meteorology officials at Ataturk airport said the visibility improved to around three km after dipping to a low of only 1,000 metres early in the morning. -- Istanbul newsroom +0212-2750875.
